From: Samir Patel <samir.p@brightretail.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, contracts@brightretail.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval conveyance ops: acceptance checklist & usage appendix

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for sending the draft MAP and the sample inventory. A couple quick clarifications before we loop legal in:

- Are prompt packs provided in raw JSON/CSV or will there be a packaged tarball? We need to confirm ingestion steps for our staging cluster.
- The acceptance checklist mentions a 14-day pilot. Can we tighten to 10 business days if we agree on a rollback window?
- We have an internal constraint: any samples containing PII (rare) must be redacted and flagged in the manifest. Your sample list currently shows some user-provided text — can you confirm redaction status?

Also, Contracts asked us to confirm the permitted use: internal model tuning vs. blackbox evaluation only. We prefer the latter for now.

Attaching our internal details (see attachment: br-eval-requirements.pdf).

Regards,
Samir
BrightRetail — Head of Platform Partnerships

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@brightretail.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval conveyance ops: acceptance checklist & usage appendix

Samir — thanks for the notes, and good call on involving Contracts. Quick replies inline: 

- Packaging: prompt packs will be delivered as a compressed tar.gz that contains a CSV manifest plus the prompts in UTF-8 CSV rows (no nested JSON payloads). We'll also provide a small ingestion script that maps columns to your staging pipeline.

- Pilot duration: we can shorten the pilot to 10 business days provided BrightRetail signs the rollback and data destruction clause (section 4.b of the MAP). That gives both teams a firm cutover/retreat plan.

- PII: we run a PII filter during curation and mark any redacted records in the manifest ("pii_redacted": "yes"). I'll attach the sanitized sample list. For anything flagged, we'll supply the exact redaction token used so your QA team can reconcile.

Regarding permitted use: our standard eval exchange is blackbox-only (no persistent model fine-tuning). If you want an exception later we can negotiate a short-term tuning window under a stricter MPA.

Next steps I propose:
1) I share the formal MAP PDF and a drive folder with the sample pack (BrightRetail_Eval_MAP_v2.pdf, promptpack_sample-list.csv).
2) Contracts (cc'ed) run a quick review of the acceptance checklist and the rollback clause.
3) If legal signs off, we send DocuSign for the MAP and schedule a 60-minute kickoff on Mon/Tue next week to hand over the ingestion script.

I'm copying Marissa and Ben for ops and account coordination.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: BrightRetail_Eval_MAP_v2.pdf (map), promptpack_sample-list.csv (sample manifest)

On Wed, Aug 19, 2026 at 09:04 AM priyom.das@redwood.ai wrote:
> Regarding permitted use: our standard eval exchange is blackbox-only (no persistent model fine-tuning).

Flagging two operational items for the MAP doc before we send to Contracts: 

- Acceptance criteria: please ensure the checklist includes the exact evaluation prompts and expected metric buckets (e.g., intent accuracy >= 86%, response latency p95 < 450ms) so we have deterministic pass/fail gates. Ben, can you add the metric rows?
- Sandbox access: BrightRetail needs ephemeral tokens that expire after 10 business days (aligned with the pilot). We'll coordinate token rotation on day 5 to satisfy our security policy. Naomi — please draft the token rotation task and the takedown playbook.

Ben: I suggest we create a minimal runbook for ingestion errors (schema mismatches) so BrightRetail's SREs can self-diagnose before pinging us. Keep it a 1-page checklist in the Drive folder.

I can incorporate these items and produce a small appendix (testcase-acceptance-checklist.xlsx) that enumerates the sample prompts, redact flags, and metric thresholds. Once attached, Priyom can re-send to Samir and Contracts.

-Marissa
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
